product_metadata.title: Hydro Peak Stainless Steel Vacuum Sealed Food Thermos Jar, Insulated Leak Proof Lunch Container Stays Warm 8 and Cold 12 Hours, Wide 20 oz (600 ml), Color Gold-Champagne (Extra Seal Gasket Included)
features: <b>Hot Or Cold<b> – The Hydro Peak stainless steel vacuumed sealed thermos food jar keeps your hot food hot for up to 8 hours and keeps your cold food cold for up to 12 hours.

<b>Durable and Sanitary<b> – Built with 18/8 rugged stainless steel, this food container is tough enough to take to work with you every day as well as hold up to the rigors of your outdoor adventures.

<b>Wide Mouth Opening<b> – The wide mouth opening of the Hydro Peak lunch container allows for easy access to the food inside. Simply eat right out of the jar. The wide mouth also allows for easy cleaning so your food jar is always fresh and ready when you need it. It has a unique lid designed with a vent that allows users to release the pressure inside to make the lid easier to open when the food jar contains hot foods or beverages.

<b>Double Wall Construction<b> – With its double wall construction the Hydro Peak stainless steel food thermos is able to keep foods out without being hot to the touch and keep foods cold without any condensation building up.
<b>Compact Design<b> – What a space saver! The optimal design of this food jar allows you to pack in the most amount of food while taking up the least about of space in your lunch box!
description: Delicious Hot or Cold Food Every Time - With its powerful vacuum insulation, the Hydro Peak food jar keeps up to 600 ml of your favorite food either hot or cold to perfection. Your food will be ready to eat when you are. Hot food stays hot for up to 8 hours, while cold food will stay cold for up to 12 hours. Whether you’re taking your food to lunch at work or for a camping trip to the great outdoors, you can trust our food jar to keep your food at the perfect temperature until you’re ready to eat it. Wider Is Better - This jars wide mouth makes eating out of it a breeze. Simply stick your fork or spoon in and eat. The mouth of the jar is wide enough to accommodate eating so that you don’t have to worry about messy spills created by trying to transfer your food from your container to a bowl or plate.The wide mouth also makes this food jar easier to clean. You can easily see of your bottle brush or sponge did the job. It not, you can simply fit a larger tool through the mouth to get your jar nice and clean. No more nasty surprises of unexpected mold or left over food stuck in the bottom of the jar. You can count on a jar that’s easy to clean.  BPA Free Compact Design - Our stainless steel food jar is BPA free and features a compact design that allows you to take it anywhere. It’s perfect for small meals on the go, wherever you’re going. In order to maximize the insulation technology, it is recommended to either pre-chill or pre-heat the container just prior to use. This can be accomplished by filling the container with cold or hot tap water, attaching the lid and letting it rest for a few minutes. Before you are ready to use, simply empty the water and fill with your favorite beverage or food. Attaching the lid will further increase the thermal efficiency.
